17 May 2023 - Annual General Meeting of Electors

Wednesday, May 17, 2023 - 06:00 PM

Location: War Memorial Hall

The Town of Cottesloe’s Annual General Meeting of Electors, to be held on Wednesday, 17 May 2023 in the War Memorial Hall, 109 Broome Street, Cottesloe, commencing at 6.00pm.

The purpose of the meeting is to discuss the contents of the 2021/2022 Annual Report (incorporating the 2021/2022 Annual Financial Statements and Auditor’s Report) and any other general business.

Council Meetings

Ordinary Council Meetings are usually held on the fourth Tuesday of the month at 6.00pm in Council Chambers at Cottesloe Civic Centre - 109 Broome Street, Cottesloe.

Meetings are conducted in line with the Local Government (Meeting Procedure) Local Law 2021 and the Local Government Act 1995.

Council Meetings

Council meetings at the Town provide a transparent and open forum where Councillors discuss local priorities, approve projects, and consider feedback from residents. Members of the community are most welcome to attend to stay informed about plans for the Town's parks, beaches and community services. Agendas and minutes are available on the Town's website, so you can see what’s being discussed and decided. We encourage you to come along or tune in online. 

Agenda Forums

Agenda Forums provide the chance to hear about items coming up at the next Council meeting and ask questions in an informal setting. They’re designed to promote transparency and help residents understand the issues being considered before decisions are made. This is an opportunity to engage with Councillors, share your thoughts, and stay informed about projects and priorities that affect Cottesloe. Agendas and minutes for Agenda Forums are available on the Town’s website.

Annual Electors' Meeting

At the Annual Electors' Meeting you can hear about the Town's progress over the past year and plans for the future. The Annual Report will be presented, including financial statements and key achievements, and residents can ask questions or raise matters that are important to them. Agendas and minutes for the Annual Electors’ Meeting are available on the Town’s website, so you can review what’s discussed and keep up to date. 

Public Participation

We warmly welcome public participation at Council meetings. These meetings are where key decisions are made about our community. You can get involved by asking a public question during question time or by making a deputation to contribute to a specific agenda item. Agendas and minutes are always available on the Town’s website so you can stay informed and prepared. Please keep in mind that the requirements of the Local Government (Meeting Procedures) Local Law 2021 apply to public participation at Council meetings.
